text:
Residents:
Priya (50s): Office worker. Weekdays: Out ~08:00-17:30. Home evenings. Weekends: Sleeps in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Movies, reading.
Dana (30s): Afternoon/night shift. Weekdays: Home mornings, out ~13:40-23:00. Weekends: Off, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Baking, gaming, movies, yoga.
Hana (30s): Office worker. Weekdays: Out ~08:00-17:30. Home evenings. Weekends: Sleeps in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Board games, napping, reading.

Object Notes:
Phones: Personal items. Typically on nightstands (b1, b2, b3) when residents are home. Carried out of house when residents leave for work/errands.
- Priya: nightstand_b1 (home) -> gone (out).
- Hana: nightstand_b3 (home) -> gone (out).
- Dana: nightstand_b2 (home) -> gone (out).

Water Bottles:
- Hana: Entry hook (return) -> Kitchen table/Counter (evening) -> Dish rack (late night).
- Priya: Entry hook (return) -> Kitchen table (evening) -> Dish rack (late night).
- Dana: Entry hook (return) -> Sink (morning) -> gone (out).
Bottles are left in entry upon return, moved to kitchen after use.

Dishes/Glasses:
- General pattern: Cupboard (stored) -> Sink/Kitchen table (use) -> Cupboard (put away).
- Hana’s glass/plate: Cupboard -> Kitchen table/Sink (evening) -> Cupboard.
- Priya’s glass/bowl/mug: Cupboard -> Kitchen table/Sink (evening) -> Cupboard.
- Dana’s bowl/mug/glass/plate: Cupboard -> Kitchen table/Counter (morning) -> Cupboard.
- Shared items (serving dish, snack bowl): Cupboard -> Kitchen table/Sink (use) -> Cupboard.

Magazines:
- Hana’s: Bookshelf (stored) -> Armchair (reading) -> Bookshelf.
- Dana’s: Coffee table (reading).

Blanket (Shared):
- Couch (day) -> Coffee table (evening) -> Armchair (night).

Remote (Shared):
- TV stand (stored) -> Coffee table (use) -> TV stand.

Snack Bowl (Shared):
- Cupboard (stored) -> Coffee table (use) -> Sink (late night).

Personal Items (Coats, Bags, Keys, Shoes):
- Entry area (hooks, table, floor, shoe rack) when residents are home.
- "Not in any room" when residents are out (carried out).
- Priya/Hana: Return to entry ~18:00-20:00.
- Dana: Returns to entry ~23:00.

Kitchen Tools (Knife, Pan, Pot, Spatula, Cutting Board, Recipe Book):
- Drawer/Cupboard/Pantry (stored) -> Counter (use) -> Sink (wash) -> Drawer/Cupboard (put away).
- Used primarily in evening (19:00-21:00) by Priya/Hana.

Laptops/Tablets:
- Priya’s laptop: Entry (return) -> Desk_b1 (work/reading).
- Dana’s tablet: Desk_b2 (rest) -> Kitchen table (morning).

Chargers:
- Hana’s: Desk_b3 -> Nightstand_b3 (overnight).

Razor:
- Priya’s: Sink_ba (use) -> Bathroom shelf (stored).
